title: Need Advice: how do I do open world rendering?
author: broker415
selftext:
(Video is from like 4 months ago game has come a long way since then) 

My game is supposed to be open world, 100 tiles each 1600x1600m 

The goal is the player can walk from one to another 

With each tile being broken into 9 grids that render and despawn as the player traverses the map 

But so far it has been a buggy mess 

Using Cursor Grok 4.5 

Think this may be a Fable 5 caliber issue though 

Please advise!

comments.author: Both_Lawfulness6708
comments.body:
Grok is too defiant, It makes the bugginess IMHO.

Fable 5 is for mukti tasking many small projects at once.

But, Sonnet 5nis great for play test, tweak, adjust, play test.

My biggest AHA moment, was having AI use other tools for art, animation, UI etc. That are specialized for that thing.

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: So which would be best for figuring out the rendering chunking for open world logic?

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: I'd use Fable.  Carefully describe what you want.

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: Yeah agreed, need to pull out the heavy hitters for this one haha

replies.author: Will_X_Intent
replies.body: The way Fable is able to not make mistakes (or catch it's own mistakes) and identify areas that other models overlook is awesome.  Really makes me want to use it for every task. replies.author: Rora2
replies.body: I'm currently trying to find out what tools work for those things. I've been using Blender with Claude (MCP and addon installed) but the results are crap. What do you recommend?

replies.author: Both_Lawfulness6708
replies.body:
Mt best recomendation is to have an explanatory conversation with AI. Claude has a research function I sometimes use to do deep research on a topic and then I have it in conversation defer to the report it gives me when I'm unsure of an exact direction.

How are you having claude use the tool?

Are you just asking it to "make blank like this"

That can lead to problems.

Set up the workflow system that best works for you.

Start by explainingto Claude that you want ABC, but your not sure about the workflow set up.

Then say that you jave tried CYZ but, with poor results.

Then ask it "What tools and set ups do you reccomend, what are some prompt ideas that can give me better results"

***,Then before you send ask it to ask you questions that will help you achieve more desired results*****

I always reccomend when I add stuff that before it just runs off creating, to show me some mockups and I will approve them.

For example, when I use pixellab, I have Grok create reference images, perplexity or Claude create lore and bundle that to get a better vibe.

Claude is better at executing this, but due to usage restraints, I will sometimes use Grok as the work horse, and look over it's work, pick out the problem areas and have Claude fix them.

comments.author: Edenisb
comments.body: Grok is not a great source of any ai generated stuff, I would suggest almost any other model to do what you are doing.

replies.author: broker415
replies.body: Haha fair enough, I was using it because Cursor included it in my usage for Grok 4.5 and it was doing a decent job for a lot of the basic stuff…. In hindsight makes sense that it couldn’t handle the logic I wanted it to here

replies.author: Edenisb
replies.body: Grok is really badly made compared to everything else I would be careful using it.
